introduction.en: GPT Image 2 is OpenAI's image generation and editing model, exposed through APIPod's primary official-route public ID. It supports prompt-driven generation and reference-image editing in the same asynchronous workflow. In APIPod, the public model ID is gpt-image-2. It supports text-to-image and image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: GPT Image 2 是 OpenAI 的图片生成与编辑模型，APIPod 通过主官方路由公开 ID 提供该能力，同一套异步工作流同时支持提示词生图和参考图编辑。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gpt-image-2，支持文生图、图片生成与编辑；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: GPT Image 2.5 Flare is the speed-focused tier of OpenAI's GPT Image 2.5 image generation and editing family, exposed through APIPod's official-route public ID. It sharpens detail, lighting and texture over GPT Image 2 and supports the extra xhigh/max fidelity tiers, making it the default choice for high-volume generation and creator content. In APIPod, the public model ID is gpt-image-2.5-flare. It supports text-to-image and image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: GPT Image 2.5 Flare 是 OpenAI GPT Image 2.5 系列中注重速度的档位，通过 APIPod 官方转发通道提供。相比 2.0 细节更锐利、光影更自然、纹理更丰富，并新增 xhigh / max 保真档，是高并发出图与创作者内容的默认选择。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gpt-image-2.5-flare，支持文生图和图片生成与编辑；接受文本和图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: GPT Image 2.5 Flare Lite is APIPod's cost-oriented routing variant for GPT Image 2.5 Flare rather than a separate OpenAI model. It uses the shared generation and editing contract with lower-cost configured channels, suited to high-volume batch generation on a budget. In APIPod, the public model ID is gpt-image-2.5-flare-lite. It supports text-to-image and image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: GPT Image 2.5 Flare 轻量版是 APIPod 面向低成本通道提供的 GPT Image 2.5 Flare 路由版本，并非独立的 OpenAI 模型。沿用相同的生成与编辑参数契约，适合对成本敏感的高并发批量出图。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gpt-image-2.5-flare-lite，支持文生图和图片生成与编辑；接受文本和图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst is the precision tier of OpenAI's GPT Image 2.5 image generation and editing family, exposed through APIPod's official-route public ID. It builds on Flare with tighter editing accuracy and multi-round controllability, suited to production-ready campaign key visuals and polished product imagery. In APIPod, the public model ID is gpt-image-2.5-sunburst. It supports text-to-image and image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst 是 OpenAI GPT Image 2.5 系列中注重精度的档位，通过 APIPod 官方转发通道提供。在 Flare 之上强化编辑精度与多轮可控性——只改指定区域、多轮编辑不走样，适合营销主视觉与精修商品图。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gpt-image-2.5-sunburst，支持文生图和图片生成与编辑；接受文本和图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst Lite is APIPod's cost-oriented routing variant for GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst rather than a separate OpenAI model. It uses the shared generation and editing contract with lower-cost configured channels, suited to iterative creative work on a budget. In APIPod, the public model ID is gpt-image-2.5-sunburst-lite. It supports text-to-image and image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst 轻量版是 APIPod 面向低成本通道提供的 GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst 路由版本，并非独立的 OpenAI 模型。沿用相同的生成与编辑参数契约，适合对成本敏感的反复打磨类创作。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gpt-image-2.5-sunburst-lite，支持文生图和图片生成与编辑；接受文本和图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: GPT Image 2 Lite is APIPod's cost-oriented routing variant for GPT Image 2 rather than a separate OpenAI model. It uses the shared generation and editing contract with lower-cost configured channels. In APIPod, the public model ID is gpt-image-2-lite. It supports text-to-image and image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: GPT Image 2 Lite 是 APIPod 面向低成本通道提供的 GPT Image 2 路由版本，并非独立的 OpenAI 模型；它沿用统一的图片生成与编辑契约。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gpt-image-2-lite，支持文生图、图片生成与编辑；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: GPT Image 2 1K is a special-offer, low-price GPT Image 2 model dedicated to 1K resolution. It is ultra-fast and ultra-cheap but slightly less stable, making it ideal for quick previews and testing; it is not recommended for production use. In APIPod, the public model ID is gpt-image-2-1k. It supports text-to-image and image generation and editing, accepts text and up to 6 reference images, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: GPT Image 2 1K 是一个针对 1K 分辨率的特价 gpt-image-2 低价生图模型，超低价格、速度超快，但稳定性稍差，适用于快速预览测试，不建议用于生产环境。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gpt-image-2-1k，支持文生图、图片生成与编辑；接受文本及最多 6 张参考图输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: GPT Image 2 Fast is APIPod's latency-oriented routing variant for GPT Image 2 rather than a separate OpenAI model. It keeps the shared generation and editing request shape while favoring faster configured channels. In APIPod, the public model ID is gpt-image-2-fast. It supports text-to-image and image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: GPT Image 2 Fast 是 APIPod 面向低延迟通道提供的 GPT Image 2 路由版本，并非独立的 OpenAI 模型；它沿用统一的图片生成与编辑请求结构。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gpt-image-2-fast，支持文生图、图片生成与编辑；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Nano Banana 2 is Google's general-purpose Gemini image generation and editing model, balancing fast generation with instruction following, text rendering, and subject consistency across reference images. In APIPod, the public model ID is nano-banana-2. It supports text-to-image and image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Nano Banana 2 是 Google Gemini 图片系列的通用型生成与编辑模型，重点兼顾生成速度、指令理解、文字渲染和多张参考图下的主体一致性。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 nano-banana-2，支持文生图、图片生成与编辑；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Nano Banana 2 Lite is the ultra-fast, low-cost tier of Google's Nano Banana 2 image generation family. In APIPod, the public model ID is nano-banana-2-lite. It generates and edits images at 1K resolution only, supports the ten standard aspect ratios (banner ratios 1:4, 4:1, 1:8, 8:1 are exclusive to nano-banana-2), accepts text and up to 14 image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Nano Banana 2 Lite 是 Google Nano Banana 2 图片生成系列的极速低价档位。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 nano-banana-2-lite，仅支持 1K 分辨率与十种常规宽高比（1:4、4:1、1:8、8:1 横幅比例为 nano-banana-2 独占）；接受文本与最多 14 张参考图输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Nano Banana Pro is Google's high-quality Gemini image model for complex creative work, with an emphasis on multimodal reasoning, real-world knowledge, precise text rendering, multi-image composition, and high-resolution output. In APIPod, the public model ID is nano-banana-pro. It supports text-to-image and image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Nano Banana Pro 是 Google Gemini 图片系列中面向复杂创作的高质量模型，强调多模态推理、现实世界知识、精细文字渲染、多图融合和高分辨率输出。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 nano-banana-pro，支持文生图、图片生成与编辑；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Nano Banana 2.1 is Google's next-generation Nano Banana 2 image generation and editing model, built on Gemini 3.6 Flash, with improved realism, visual design, text rendering and character consistency across editing turns. In APIPod, the public model ID is nano-banana-2.1. It generates and edits images at 1K, 2K or 4K (the 512px tier is not supported), accepts text and up to 14 image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Nano Banana 2.1 是 Google 基于 Gemini 3.6 Flash 打造的新一代 Nano Banana 2 图片生成与编辑模型，写实度、视觉设计、文字渲染与多轮编辑中的角色一致性全面提升。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 nano-banana-2.1，支持 1K、2K、4K 分辨率（不支持 512px 档）；接受文本与最多 14 张参考图输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedream 4.5 is ByteDance's text-to-image model for prompt-faithful composition, detailed visual styles, and text rendering. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedream-v4.5. It supports text-to-image, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedream 4.5 是字节跳动的文生图模型，重点提升提示词遵循、画面构图、视觉风格和文字渲染能力。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedream-v4.5，支持文生图；接受文本输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedream 4.5 Edit is ByteDance's reference-image editing model, designed to preserve subjects and fine details while following transformation instructions across one or more source images. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedream-v4.5-edit. It supports image generation and editing, accepts image and text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedream 4.5 Edit 是字节跳动的参考图编辑模型，适合在一张或多张源图片之间保持主体和细节，并按提示词完成可控修改。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedream-v4.5-edit，支持图片生成与编辑；接受图片、文本输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedream 5.0 Lite is APIPod's efficiency-oriented text-to-image route in the Seedream 5 family, intended for prompt-driven generation with flexible high-resolution output. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedream-5.0-lite. It supports text-to-image, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedream 5.0 Lite 是 APIPod 在 Seedream 5 系列中开放的效率型文生图路由，面向提示词驱动和灵活的高分辨率图片生成。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedream-5.0-lite，支持文生图；接受文本输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedream 5.0 Lite Edit is APIPod's efficiency-oriented Seedream 5 route for reference-guided image editing and subject-consistent transformations. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedream-5.0-lite-edit. It supports image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedream 5.0 Lite Edit 是 APIPod 在 Seedream 5 系列中开放的效率型图片编辑路由，用于参考图引导和保持主体一致性的图像修改。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedream-5.0-lite-edit，支持图片生成与编辑；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedream 5.0 Pro is the flagship tier of ByteDance's Seedream 5 family, focused on prompt fidelity, legible text rendering, and photorealistic detail. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedream-5.0-pro. It generates a single 1K or 2K image per request in PNG or JPEG, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedream 5.0 Pro 是字节跳动 Seedream 5 系列的旗舰档位，重点提升提示词遵循、文字渲染清晰度和写实细节。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedream-5.0-pro，每次请求生成 1 张 1K 或 2K 的 PNG / JPEG 图片；接受文本输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedream 5.0 Pro Edit is the reference-guided editing mode of Seedream 5.0 Pro, supporting multi-image composition and interactive edits driven by hand-drawn marks or <bbox>/<point> coordinates in the prompt. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedream-5.0-pro-edit. It accepts text and 1-10 reference images, outputs a single 1K or 2K image, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedream 5.0 Pro Edit 是 Seedream 5.0 Pro 的参考图编辑模式，支持多图融合，以及基于手绘标记或提示词中 <bbox>/<point> 坐标的交互式编辑。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedream-5.0-pro-edit，接受文本与 1-10 张参考图输入，每次输出 1 张 1K 或 2K 图片，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedream 5.0 Pro Layer decomposes one design image into a base image and up to 16 transparent PNG layers. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedream-5.0-pro-layer. It accepts a prompt and one image URL in image_url, returns each layer as an object in result with its url, z_index, bounding box, name, and description, and is billed once per request.
introduction.zh: Seedream 5.0 Pro 图层拆分可将 1 张设计图拆成底图和最多 16 个透明 PNG 图层。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedream-5.0-pro-layer，接受提示词与 image_url 传入的 1 个图片地址，result 中每一项都是包含图层 url、z_index、位置框、名称和描述的对象，按次计费。

introduction.en: Seedream 5.0 Flash is the faster tier of ByteDance's Seedream 5 family with Pro-level prompt fidelity and text rendering. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedream-5.0-flash. It generates a single 1K, 1.5K or 2K image per request in PNG or JPEG, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedream 5.0 Flash 是字节跳动 Seedream 5 系列的极速档位，提示词遵循与文字渲染达到 Pro 水准。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedream-5.0-flash，每次请求生成 1 张 1K、1.5K 或 2K 的 PNG / JPEG 图片；接受文本输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedream 5.0 Flash Edit is the faster reference-guided editing mode of the Seedream 5 family. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedream-5.0-flash-edit. It accepts text and 1-10 reference images, supports interactive edits and transparent-background editing of a single PNG input, and returns one image through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedream 5.0 Flash Edit 是 Seedream 5 系列中更快速的参考图编辑模式。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedream-5.0-flash-edit，接受文本与 1-10 张参考图输入，支持交互式编辑和对单张透明 PNG 的透明背景编辑，并通过异步图片任务返回 1 张图片。

introduction.en: Seedream 5.0 Flash Layer is the faster layer-decomposition mode of the Seedream 5 family. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedream-5.0-flash-layer. It accepts a prompt and one image URL in image_url, outputs a base image plus up to 16 transparent PNG layers as objects in result with url, z_index, bounding box, name, and description, and is billed once per request.
introduction.zh: Seedream 5.0 Flash 图层拆分是 Seedream 5 系列中更快速的图层拆分模式。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedream-5.0-flash-layer，接受提示词与 image_url 传入的 1 个图片地址，输出底图和最多 16 个透明 PNG 图层，result 中每一项都是包含 url、z_index、位置框、名称和描述的对象，按次计费。

introduction.en: Wan 2.7 Image is Alibaba's text-to-image model with an optional reasoning stage for interpreting prompts and planning composition before rendering. In APIPod, the public model ID is wan2.7-image. It supports text-to-image, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Wan 2.7 Image 是阿里的文生图模型，可通过可选的生成前推理理解提示词并规划构图。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 wan2.7-image，支持文生图；接受文本输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Wan 2.7 Image Edit is Alibaba's instruction-based image editing model for controlled changes that preserve the source structure and principal subjects. In APIPod, the public model ID is wan2.7-image-edit. It supports image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Wan 2.7 Image Edit 是阿里的指令式图片编辑模型，用于在保留原图结构和主要主体的同时完成可控修改。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 wan2.7-image-edit，支持图片生成与编辑；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Wan 2.7 Image Pro is the high-resolution text-to-image route in APIPod's Wan 2.7 image family, with a 4K output tier for detailed or large-format assets. In APIPod, the public model ID is wan2.7-image-pro. It supports text-to-image, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Wan 2.7 Image Pro 是 APIPod Wan 2.7 图片系列中的高分辨率文生图路由，提供 4K 输出档位，适合细节丰富或大尺寸素材。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 wan2.7-image-pro，支持文生图；接受文本输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Wan 2.7 Image Pro Edit is the quality-oriented editing route in APIPod's Wan 2.7 image family, combining reference images with text instructions for high-fidelity changes. In APIPod, the public model ID is wan2.7-image-pro-edit. It supports image generation and editing, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous image tasks.
introduction.zh: Wan 2.7 Image Pro Edit 是 APIPod Wan 2.7 图片系列中的质量优先编辑路由，通过参考图片和文本指令完成高保真修改。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 wan2.7-image-pro-edit，支持图片生成与编辑；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步图片任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Veo 3.1 Fast is a fast-generation route based on Google Veo 3.1. It supports text or first/last-frame image guidance and can generate video with audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is veo3-1-fast. It supports text-to-video and image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Veo 3.1 Fast 基于 Google Veo 3.1，属于快速生成路由，支持文本或首尾帧图片引导，并可生成带音频的视频。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 veo3-1-fast，支持文生视频、图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Veo 3.1 Fast 4K is a fast-generation route based on Google Veo 3.1. It supports text or first/last-frame image guidance and can generate video with audio, with this public ID targeting 4K output. In APIPod, the public model ID is veo3-1-fast-4k. It supports text-to-video and image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Veo 3.1 Fast 4K 基于 Google Veo 3.1，属于快速生成路由，支持文本或首尾帧图片引导，并可生成带音频的视频；该公开 ID 以 4K 输出为目标。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 veo3-1-fast-4k，支持文生视频、图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Veo 3.1 Fast Ref is Google Veo 3.1's multi-reference video route, using up to three subject or style images to guide character, lighting, and color consistency. In APIPod, the public model ID is veo3-1-fast-ref. It supports image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Veo 3.1 Fast Ref 是 Google Veo 3.1 的多参考图视频路由，可使用最多 3 张主体或风格参考图控制角色、光线和色调的一致性。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 veo3-1-fast-ref，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Veo 3.1 Quality is a quality-focused route based on Google Veo 3.1. It supports text or first/last-frame image guidance and can generate video with audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is veo3-1-quality. It supports text-to-video and image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Veo 3.1 Quality 基于 Google Veo 3.1，属于质量优先路由，支持文本或首尾帧图片引导，并可生成带音频的视频。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 veo3-1-quality，支持文生视频、图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Veo 3.1 Quality 4K is a quality-focused route based on Google Veo 3.1. It supports text or first/last-frame image guidance and can generate video with audio, with this public ID targeting 4K output. In APIPod, the public model ID is veo3-1-quality-4k. It supports text-to-video and image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Veo 3.1 Quality 4K 基于 Google Veo 3.1，属于质量优先路由，支持文本或首尾帧图片引导，并可生成带音频的视频；该公开 ID 以 4K 输出为目标。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 veo3-1-quality-4k，支持文生视频、图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedance 2.0 Text to Video is a standard route that turns text instructions into video without requiring source media. The Seedance family emphasizes prompt following, coherent motion, multi-shot storytelling, and synchronized audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedance-2.0-t2v. It supports text-to-video, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedance 2.0 文生视频是标准路由，根据文本指令生成视频，不要求提供源媒体。Seedance 系列强调提示词遵循、连贯运动、多镜头叙事和音画同步。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedance-2.0-t2v，支持文生视频；接受文本输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedance 2.0 Image to Video is a standard route that animates a required first-frame image and can use an optional last frame where the public schema allows it. The Seedance family emphasizes prompt following, coherent motion, multi-shot storytelling, and synchronized audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedance-2.0-i2v. It supports image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.

It supports text-to-video, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.

introduction.zh: Seedance 2.0 Fast 图生视频是低延迟路由，以必填首帧图片生成视频，并在公开 schema 允许时使用可选尾帧。Seedance 系列强调提示词遵循、连贯运动、多镜头叙事和音画同步。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedance-2.0-fast-i2v，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片、音频、视频输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedance 2.0 Fast Reference to Video is a lower-latency route that uses reference images, video, or audio to guide subjects, motion, visual style, and sound. The Seedance family emphasizes prompt following, coherent motion, multi-shot storytelling, and synchronized audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedance-2.0-fast-r2v. It supports text-to-video, image-to-video and video-to-video, accepts text, image, audio and video inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.

In APIPod, the public model ID is grok-imagine-t2v. It supports text-to-video, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.

In APIPod, the public model ID is grok-imagine-i2v. It supports image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.

introduction.en: Grok Imagine 1.5 Fast is a fast route for longer clips and multiple reference images in xAI's Grok Imagine video family, intended for short clips with coherent motion and synchronized audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is grok-imagine-1.5-fast. It supports image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Grok Imagine 1.5 Fast 是 xAI Grok Imagine 视频系列的面向较长片段和多参考图的快速路由，用于生成带连贯运动和同步音频的短视频。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 grok-imagine-1.5-fast，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Grok Imagine 1.5 Preview is a preview route that requires one source image in xAI's Grok Imagine video family, intended for short clips with coherent motion and synchronized audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is grok-imagine-1.5-preview. It supports image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Grok Imagine 1.5 Preview 是 xAI Grok Imagine 视频系列的要求单张源图片的预览路由，用于生成带连贯运动和同步音频的短视频。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 grok-imagine-1.5-preview，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Sora 2 VIP is APIPod's official-provider routing ID for Sora 2. Its public contract supports 4-, 8-, or 12-second clips and an optional first-frame image. In APIPod, the public model ID is sora-2-vip. It supports text-to-video and image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Sora 2 VIP 是 APIPod 为 Sora 2 提供的官方供应商路由 ID，公开契约支持 4、8、12 秒视频以及可选首帧图片。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 sora-2-vip，支持文生视频、图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Gemini Omni T2V is APIPod's text-to-video routing mode for the configured Gemini Omni channel. It uses text instructions to create video without requiring reference media. In APIPod, the public model ID is gemini-omni-t2v. It supports text-to-video, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Gemini Omni T2V 是 APIPod 为已配置 Gemini Omni 通道提供的文生视频路由模式，仅使用文本指令生成视频，不要求参考素材。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gemini-omni-t2v，支持文生视频；接受文本输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Gemini Omni I2V is APIPod's first/last-frame image-to-video routing mode for the configured Gemini Omni channel. It accepts one required first frame and one optional last frame. In APIPod, the public model ID is gemini-omni-i2v. It supports image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Gemini Omni I2V 是 APIPod 为已配置 Gemini Omni 通道提供的首尾帧图生视频路由模式，要求提供首帧，并可选提供尾帧。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gemini-omni-i2v，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Gemini Omni R2V is APIPod's reference-to-video routing mode for the configured Gemini Omni channel. It uses one to five reference images to guide subject and visual consistency. In APIPod, the public model ID is gemini-omni-r2v. It supports image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Gemini Omni R2V 是 APIPod 为已配置 Gemini Omni 通道提供的参考生视频路由模式，支持使用 1 至 5 张参考图引导主体和视觉一致性。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gemini-omni-r2v，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Gemini Omni Extend is APIPod's video extension and editing routing mode for the configured Gemini Omni channel. It requires a source video and can attach up to five reference images. In APIPod, the public model ID is gemini-omni-extend. It supports video-to-video, accepts text, video and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Gemini Omni Extend 是 APIPod 为已配置 Gemini Omni 通道提供的视频续写与编辑路由模式，要求提供源视频，并可附带最多 5 张参考图。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 gemini-omni-extend，支持视频到视频；接受文本、视频、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: MiniMax H3 is the all-in-one model of MiniMax's multimodal H3 video family: one public model ID covers every scenario. Prompt-only requests are text-to-video, 1-2 images in image_urls are image-to-video with first/last frame control, and the role field set to reference_images, any reference video, or audio selects reference generation. In APIPod, the public model ID is minimax-h3. It accepts up to 9 reference images, 3 videos, and 3 audios, outputs 768P or 2K for 4-15 seconds, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks. Text-to-video requests require an explicit aspect_ratio.
introduction.zh: MiniMax H3 是 MiniMax 多模态 H3 视频系列的 all-in-one 模型：一个公开模型 ID 覆盖全部场景。只传提示词即文生视频，image_urls 传 1-2 张图即图生视频（首帧/首尾帧），role=reference_images、参考视频或参考音频即参考生视频。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 minimax-h3，参考素材上限为图 9 / 视频 3 / 音频 3，输出 768P 或 2K、时长 4-15 秒，通过异步视频任务返回结果。文生视频场景必须显式传 aspect_ratio。

introduction.en: MiniMax H3 T2V is the prompt-only text-to-video mode of MiniMax H3. APIPod exposes 768P and native 2K output with 4-to-15-second generation for this public ID. In APIPod, the public model ID is minimax-h3-t2v. It supports text-to-video, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: MiniMax H3 T2V 是 MiniMax H3 的纯文生视频模式；APIPod 为该公开 ID 开放 768P、原生 2K 输出和 4 至 15 秒视频生成。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 minimax-h3-t2v，支持文生视频；接受文本输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: MiniMax H3 Image to Video is a dedicated mode in MiniMax's multimodal H3 video family that uses a required first frame and an optional last frame. APIPod currently exposes a 768P or 2K, 4-to-15-second asynchronous contract for this family. In APIPod, the public model ID is minimax-h3-i2v. It supports image-to-video, accepts text, video and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: MiniMax H3 图生视频是 MiniMax H3 多模态视频系列的独立模式，使用必填首帧和可选尾帧；APIPod 当前为该系列提供 768P 或 2K、4 至 15 秒的异步生成契约。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 minimax-h3-i2v，支持图生视频；接受文本、视频、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: MiniMax H3 Reference to Video is a dedicated mode in MiniMax's multimodal H3 video family that combines image, video, and audio references. APIPod currently exposes a 768P or 2K, 4-to-15-second asynchronous contract for this family. In APIPod, the public model ID is minimax-h3-r2v. It supports image-to-video and video-to-video, accepts text, image, audio and video inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: MiniMax H3 参考生视频是 MiniMax H3 多模态视频系列的独立模式，组合图片、视频和音频参考素材；APIPod 当前为该系列提供 768P 或 2K、4 至 15 秒的异步生成契约。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 minimax-h3-r2v，支持图生视频、视频到视频；接受文本、图片、音频、视频输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Grok Imagine 1.5 VIP is APIPod's official-channel image-to-video route for Grok Imagine 1.5. It requires a source image and supports 480p, 720p or 1080p clips up to 15 seconds, with up to three narration voices on the GA official upstream. In APIPod, the public model ID is grok-imagine-1.5-vip. It supports image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Grok Imagine 1.5 VIP 是 APIPod 为 Grok Imagine 1.5 提供的官方通道路由，仅支持图生视频，要求提供源图片，可生成最长 15 秒的 480p、720p 或 1080p 视频，支持最多 3 个旁白音色（官转 GA 上游）。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 grok-imagine-1.5-vip，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Kling 2.6 Motion Control transfers motion and timing from a reference video to a character or subject in a reference image, with optional preservation of the reference video's audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is kling-2.6-motion-control. It supports text-to-video, image-to-video and video-to-video, accepts text, image and video inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Kling 2.6 Motion Control 是可灵的动作控制模型，将参考视频中的动作和时序迁移到参考图片中的人物或主体，并可按请求保留参考视频音频。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 kling-2.6-motion-control，支持文生视频、图生视频、视频到视频；接受文本、图片、视频输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Motion Control M1 transfers the action and timing of a reference video to a subject supplied in a reference image, producing a new asynchronous video result. In APIPod, the public model ID is motion-control-m1. It supports video-to-video, accepts image and video inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Motion Control M1 将参考视频中的动作与节奏迁移到参考图片中的主体，生成新的异步视频结果。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 motion-control-m1，支持视频到视频；接受图片、视频输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

introduction.en: Seedance 2.5 Video Edit pins the omni-reference task type to video editing. Provide the source video (4-30 seconds) plus optional reference images or audios and describe the edit; the output keeps the source timeline, aspect ratio, and duration - duration and aspect_ratio are not exposed and any passed values are ignored. Constraints are validated at submission time, so incompatible parameters fail fast instead of erroring asynchronously. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedance-2.5-edit, and results are returned through asynchronous video tasks.

Provide the source video and describe the forward or backward continuation; the output is 4-30 seconds and the aspect ratio automatically follows the source video (not settable; any passed value is ignored). Constraints are validated at submission time, so incompatible parameters fail fast instead of erroring asynchronously. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedance-2.5-extend, and results are returned through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedance 2.5 视频延长将全模态参考子任务固定为视频延长：传入源视频并描述向前或向后延续；输出 4-30 秒，画幅自动跟随源视频（不可设置，传入忽略）。子任务参数限制在提交时同步校验，不再异步报错。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedance-2.5-extend，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

example_prompts: 延长@视频1，窗户打开后进入@视频2的美术馆室内，最后镜头进入@视频3的画内

pages.title: Seedance 2.5 Draft

introduction.en: Seedance 2.5 Draft is a two-stage workflow: submit a normal request to create a low-cost 480p draft preview, then submit the completed draft's task ID as draft_task_id to render the 1080p final video. The final video reuses the draft prompt, media, duration, aspect ratio, seed, and audio setting, and always runs on the same generation account as the draft. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedance-2.5-draft, and results are returned through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedance 2.5 Draft 是两段式工作流：按普通请求提交生成低成本的 480p 样片，样片完成后把其任务 ID 作为 draft_task_id 提交即可生成 1080p 成片。成片复用样片的提示词、素材、时长、画幅、seed 与音频设置，并固定在生成样片的同一账号上执行。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedance-2.5-draft，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

example_prompts: 女孩抱着狐狸，女孩睁开眼，温柔地看向镜头，狐狸友善地抱着，镜头缓缓拉出，女孩的头发被风吹动，可以听到风声

displayName.zh: Seedance 2.5 特价版 文生视频

introduction.en: Seedance 2.5 Lite Text to Video is the special-price full-capability route that turns text instructions into video without requiring source media. It generates up to 30 seconds of video with synchronized native audio and outputs 720p only. The Seedance family emphasizes prompt following, coherent motion, multi-shot storytelling, and synchronized audio. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedance-2.5-lite-t2v. It supports text-to-video, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.
introduction.zh: Seedance 2.5 特价版文生视频是特价版满血路由，根据文本指令生成视频，不要求提供源媒体。单次最长 30 秒，音画同步生成，仅输出 720p。Seedance 系列强调提示词遵循、连贯运动、多镜头叙事和音画同步。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedance-2.5-lite-t2v，支持文生视频；接受文本输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。

displayName.zh: Seedance 2.5 特价版 图生视频

introduction.en: Seedance 2.5 Lite Image to Video is the special-price full-capability route that animates a first frame (and optionally a last frame) into video. It supports durations up to 30 seconds and outputs 720p only. This is a full-capability variant where media URLs are reviewed by the asset service before the task is submitted, so plain public URLs still work in requests. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedance-2.5-lite-i2v. It supports image-to-video, accepts text and image inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks.

introduction.en: Seedance 2.0 X Text to Video is APIPod's lowest-cost Seedance 2.0 route, billed at a flat price per request regardless of duration. It turns text prompts into 5-15 second 720p videos in 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 1:1 or 21:9. It is less stable than the official and deal editions, with longer queues and higher failure rates at peak times; seed, generate_audio and watermark are not supported. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedance-2.0-x-t2v. It supports text-to-video, accepts text inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks. The current APIPod model catalog marks it as beta.

displayName.zh: Seedance 2.0 X 低价版（参考生视频）

introduction.en: Seedance 2.0 X Reference to Video is APIPod's lowest-cost Seedance 2.0 multimodal route, billed at a flat price per request regardless of duration or reference length. It combines up to 9 reference images, 3 videos and 3 audios into a 5-15 second 720p video; audio must be paired with at least one image or video. First/last-frame image-to-video is not offered on this tier because the upstream has no dedicated frame fields. In APIPod, the public model ID is seedance-2.0-x-r2v. It supports image-to-video, accepts text, image and video inputs, and returns results through asynchronous video tasks. The current APIPod model catalog marks it as beta.
introduction.zh: Seedance 2.0 X 低价版参考生视频是 APIPod 中成本最低的 Seedance 2.0 多模态路由，按次固定计费，与时长和参考素材长度无关。最多组合 9 张参考图、3 段视频与 3 段音频，生成 5–15 秒、720P 的视频；音频需搭配至少一张图片或一段视频。由于上游没有独立的首尾帧字段，该档位不提供首尾帧图生视频。在 APIPod 中，公开模型 ID 为 seedance-2.0-x-r2v，支持图生视频；接受文本、图片、视频输入，并通过异步视频任务返回结果。当前 APIPod 模型目录将其标记为beta。
